Package neqsim.thermo.util.mineral

Class StandardStateSpecies

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.util.mineral.StandardStateSpecies
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class StandardStateSpecies extends Object implements Serializable
Phase-specific standard-state thermochemistry for a pure species in a heterogeneous reaction.

Thermochemical functions are referenced to the standard pressure of 1 bar. The apparent Gibbs energy follows the Benson-Helgeson convention, G(T) = dfH298 + [H(T) - H298] - T S(T), where element contributions cancel for any atom-balanced reaction. Heat capacity can be described by NIST-JANAF Shomate segments (which carry transition enthalpies in their segment constants) or by the Robie and Hemingway (1995) polynomial Cp = A1 + A2 T + A3/T^2 + A4/T^0.5 + A5 T^2. Outside the tabulated data range the heat capacity is held at its boundary value and the state is reported as extrapolated by isWithinDataRange(double).

Pressure dependence of a condensed phase is represented by the integral I(T,P), the integral of the molar volume from 1 bar to P. Solids use a constant molar volume; liquid water uses the IAPWS-IF97 Region 1 Gibbs function. Ideal-gas species have no pressure term: their non-ideality belongs in the fugacity calculated by an equation of state.

      private StandardStateSpecies(String name, StandardStateSpecies.Phase phase, Map<String,Double> elements, double formationEnthalpy298, double entropy298, StandardStateSpecies.CpForm cpForm, double[][] coefficients, double[] segmentMinTemperature, double[] segmentMaxTemperature, StandardStateSpecies.PressureModel pressureModel, double molarVolume, double formationEnthalpyUncertainty, double entropyUncertainty, String source)
      Creates a species. Use the static factory methods for documented data sets.
      Parameters:
      name - species name
      phase - reference phase
      elements - element composition (element symbol to atoms per formula unit)
      formationEnthalpy298 - standard enthalpy of formation at 298.15 K [J/mol]
      entropy298 - third-law entropy at 298.15 K [J/(mol K)], or NaN to evaluate from Shomate
      cpForm - heat-capacity representation
      coefficients - coefficient rows, one row per temperature segment
      segmentMinTemperature - lower temperature limit of each segment [K]
      segmentMaxTemperature - upper temperature limit of each segment [K]
      pressureModel - pressure-integral model
      molarVolume - molar volume for StandardStateSpecies.PressureModel.CONSTANT_VOLUME [m3/mol]
      formationEnthalpyUncertainty - enthalpy-of-formation uncertainty [J/mol], NaN if unknown
      entropyUncertainty - entropy uncertainty [J/(mol K)], NaN if unknown
      source - literature source of the data
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the segment arrays or the volume are inconsistent

  • Method Details

    • shomate

      public static StandardStateSpecies shomate(String name, StandardStateSpecies.Phase phase, Map<String,Double> elements, double[][] coefficients, double[] segmentMinTemperature, double[] segmentMaxTemperature, StandardStateSpecies.PressureModel pressureModel, double molarVolume, double formationEnthalpyUncertainty, double entropyUncertainty, String source)
      Creates a species from NIST-JANAF Shomate segments.

      Each row holds A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H with t = T/1000: Cp = A + B t + C t^2 + D t^3 + E/t^2 [J/(mol K)], H - H298 = A t + B t^2/2 + C t^3/3 + D t^4/4 - E/t + F - H [kJ/mol] and S = A ln t + B t + C t^2/2 + D t^3/3 - E/(2 t^2) + G [J/(mol K)]. Coefficient H is the enthalpy of formation at 298.15 K in kJ/mol.

      Parameters:
      name - species name
      phase - reference phase
      elements - element composition
      coefficients - Shomate rows A to H, one per segment
      segmentMinTemperature - lower limit of each segment [K]
      segmentMaxTemperature - upper limit of each segment [K]
      pressureModel - pressure-integral model
      molarVolume - molar volume [m3/mol]; ignored unless the model is constant volume
      formationEnthalpyUncertainty - enthalpy-of-formation uncertainty [J/mol], NaN if unknown
      entropyUncertainty - entropy uncertainty [J/(mol K)], NaN if unknown
      source - literature source
      Returns:
      the species
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a row does not have eight coefficients

    • robieHemingway

      source - literature source
      Returns:

      Throws:
